title.en: Complete twelve-language coverage across public and protected routes
title.zh: 完成公开与受保护页面的十二语言覆盖

purpose.en: Remove the remaining English-only deep-route fallbacks so the selected locale survives navigation through every GreatLoveMeta page family.
purpose.zh: 移除残留的深层页面英文回退，让所选语言贯穿大爱元宇宙的全部页面类型。

en: Keep all public, member, course, game, swap, payment, admin, and Project routes on the selected one of twelve locales.
Translate late-rendered interface text while protecting the twelve native language names from accidental translation.
zh: 公开、会员、课程、游戏、兑换、支付、管理及 Project 页面均保留所选的十二语言路由。
翻译后加载的界面文字，同时保护十二个语言母语名称不被错误翻译。

en: Every app/[lang] page family, shared header and footer, internal links, and protected-page redirects.
Desktop and hamburger language controls, late client-rendered content, deployment checks, and Project release history.
zh: 全部 app/[lang] 页面类型、共享页眉页脚、内部链接及受保护页面跳转。
桌面与汉堡菜单语言控件、客户端后加载内容、部署检查和 Project 发布历史。

en: Replace two-language route guards with validated twelve-language routing and preserve the actual locale in the shared shell.
Add a site-local locale runtime and complete static dictionaries for dynamic interface text and same-origin links.
zh: 以十二语言校验替换中英文路由限制，并让共享外壳保留真实语言。
新增站点本地语言运行层及完整静态词典，处理动态界面文字和站内链接。

en: Complete repository tests, the deep-route localization contract, production build, artifact and shared gates pass before publication.
Production Chrome click-through checks cover Japanese and Korean home, sign-in, pricing, legal, editorial, course, game, and protected redirect flows.
zh: 发布前通过完整仓库测试、深层路由语言契约、生产构建、制品及共享门禁。
生产 Chrome 实际点击覆盖日语与韩语首页、登录、定价、法律、编辑、课程、游戏及受保护页面跳转。

en: User-created course titles, community posts, and other member content remain in their authored language rather than being machine-translated.
zh: 用户创建的课程标题、社区帖子及其他会员内容保留原始语言，不进行机器翻译。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, ecosystem destinations, independent data, and cloud resources while adopting true locale routing.
zh: 采用真实语言路由时，保留 GreatLoveMeta 的品牌、生态目的地、独立数据与云资源。
